verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a first-party Realtime API that pushes live run updates and streams data from running tasks to the frontend without polling. It also explicitly supports forwarding AI-provider token streams to users. A community user corroborates using the hooks to return progress updates to the UI during long OpenAI calls. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the frontend hooks/SDK and step-level progress metadata, and detail on stream limits or reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I stream live progress — step updates or model tokens — from a running workflow into my frontend as it executes

citations.quote: Get live run updates and stream data from background tasks to your frontend or backend. No polling.
Forward streams through the Realtime API to provide real-time updates to your users from any AI providers.
The hooks are great for returning multiple values/progress updates to the UI.
